decisions.rationale: The initial education review showed that comment tokens could pass the code checker. Later exact-byte review verified parser, behavior, and structure checks, and final approval retained this HTML and GIFT identity.

The final education review correctly found that failed settled checkpoints still received completion and credit. Subsequent approved bytes derive completion and credit from passing evidence.

Current critic evidence was absent at the reviewed checkpoint. The exact-head critic records added by this non-author reconciliation address that evidence gap.
The learner-visible source-date mismatch was valid and the later approval retained the corrected current bytes.
